q: How does a dental clinic work out its carbon footprint?
title: Dental clinic carbon footprint
short: Start with the electricity bill, then add any nitrous oxide used for sedation, LPG or diesel, and the main purchases: consumables, instruments and lab work. Nitrous oxide is a direct Scope 1 emission with a global warming potential of 273, so a few cylinders matter.
audience: Dental clinics and small hospital chains

ul: Electricity for chairs, compressors, autoclaves and air conditioning.
Patient travel, if you choose to estimate it.

example.title: Nitrous oxide
lines: 20 kg N2O in a year x 273 = 5,460 kg CO2e

senseible: Senseible reads quantities, dates and units from your bills and invoices and shows the factor and source used on every line.

sources.label: IPCC AR6 WG1, global warming potentials
